visual_logic.surface_detail: Deep 'Midnight Blue' skin with high-gloss finish to handle extreme water pressure, running uniformly across its full horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the massive, saucer-shaped orbit and reflective pupil, oriented perfectly to face laterally in the frame.
visual_logic.environment: The transition zone between sunlit surface and the dark 'Twilight Zone' of the sea. Light gradients are smoothed horizontally across the background layer to keep the silhouette sharp.
visual_logic.pose: The ichthyosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original vertical dive position is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its dolphin-like snout, robust torso, dorsal fin, and deep tail fluke end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system. The massive eye catches a stray beam of light hitting parallel to the camera plane.
